title: Build a simple home lab
description: Set up virtual machines and an intentionally vulnerable target in an isolated lab.
safety_note: Keep vulnerable targets isolated; do not expose them to the public internet or test systems without authorization.

title: Security lab notes and CTF portfolio
description: Publish lab notes, CTF writeups, screenshots, and lessons learned on GitHub.
safety_note: Do not publish secrets, credentials, personal data, or exploit details for live third-party targets.

title: Basic incident-response checklist
description: Create a checklist for a common security incident scenario.

title: Personal security-hygiene guide
description: Create a guide to safe digital habits that can be taught to peers or a community group.

title: Beginner CTF writeups
description: Solve beginner challenges on authorized CTF platforms and document the approach and lessons learned.
safety_note: Only interact with the CTF targets and systems authorized by the platform.

title: Complete one guided DataCamp project
description: Use a guided project or a small self-made project to apply skills from the chosen track.

title: Two-minute data story
description: Prepare a short explanation of a data question, approach, finding, and limitation.

title: Data vocabulary and learning notes
description: Keep structured notes on terms, formulas, common mistakes, and learning progress.

title: Publish a project notebook
description: Publish a notebook or project artifact and summarize what was learned on GitHub or LinkedIn.

title: Static personal website
description: Deploy a static personal website using S3 and CloudFront.
safety_note: Verify current service pricing, access settings, and cleanup steps before deploying.

title: Serverless API
description: Build an API using Lambda and API Gateway with a simple database.
safety_note: Restrict permissions and set cost controls; review current pricing.

title: Cloud resume
description: Build a cloud-hosted resume project using the Cloud Resume Challenge as a guide.
safety_note: Follow current challenge guidance and verify costs for all selected services.

title: Simple monitoring dashboard
description: Create a simple dashboard using CloudWatch basics.
safety_note: Monitoring and logs may incur charges; check current pricing and retention settings.

title: Deploy a small application
description: Deploy a small app using a container or managed platform.
safety_note: Check pricing and stop/delete unused resources.

title: Calculator or short quiz
description: Build a simple interactive calculator or quiz to practise variables, conditions, functions, and input/output.
expected_deliverable: Working browser-based project with a short README or explanation.

title: Number-guessing game
description: Create a game that compares a user's guess with a target and gives feedback; use loops or repeated attempts where appropriate.
expected_deliverable: Playable game and a brief explanation of the logic.

title: Simple to-do list
description: Make a small to-do list that lets a user add and view tasks; keep the scope beginner-friendly.
expected_deliverable: Working list with clearly documented features and limitations.

title: Final mini-project: quiz, calculator, or interactive story
description: Choose a manageable idea, plan it, build it in steps, test it, and publish it.
expected_deliverable: Public GitHub repository or Replit project, screenshots if useful, and a short learning reflection.

title: Quantum random number generator simulation
expected_deliverable: Notebook that samples outcomes from a simulated circuit
notes: Educational simulation only; do not claim certified randomness or use for production security.

title: BB84-style key distribution simulation
expected_deliverable: Notebook explaining state preparation, measurement, and eavesdropping detection
notes: Educational simulation only; not a production cryptographic implementation.

title: Quantum teleportation circuit
expected_deliverable: Annotated circuit and explanation of classical communication and entanglement
notes: Explain the protocol accurately; it does not teleport matter or enable faster-than-light communication.

title: Tiny Grover search
expected_deliverable: Small circuit, simulator results, and comparison with classical search
notes: Use a tiny toy example and avoid claims of practical quantum advantage.

title: Variational circuit experiment
expected_deliverable: Experiment notebook varying circuit parameters and reporting results

title: AI incident case study
expected_deliverable: Short report documenting incident, stakeholders, harms, and mitigations
notes: Separate observed facts from inference and cite original sources.

title: Model evaluation card
expected_deliverable: Evaluation plan with target behavior, test cases, metrics, and limitations
notes: Do not claim evaluation proves a model is safe in all contexts.

title: Red-team a small demo model
expected_deliverable: Documented test set, failure categories, and mitigation suggestions
notes: Use only systems and datasets you are authorized to test.

title: AI policy comparison brief
expected_deliverable: Comparison of two policy approaches with stakeholder trade-offs
notes: Distinguish legal requirements, voluntary standards, and personal recommendations.

title: Dataset documentation and risk review
expected_deliverable: Dataset datasheet with provenance, consent concerns, representation gaps, and intended use
notes: Do not publish sensitive personal data.

title: Campus event project plan
expected_deliverable: Scope, timeline, task board, budget assumptions, and risk register
notes: Use a real or realistic event and note assumptions.

title: Student group workflow automation
expected_deliverable: Form-to-task flow plus weekly summary and exception handling
notes: Use dummy data until permissions and privacy are clear.

title: NGO mini-program delivery plan
expected_deliverable: Stakeholder map, delivery plan, monitoring metrics, and retrospective
notes: Include accessibility, safeguarding, and resource constraints.

title: Airtable project dashboard
expected_deliverable: Dashboard for tasks, owners, due dates, status, and risks
notes: Avoid entering confidential personal data into a public demo.

title: Productivity system case study
expected_deliverable: Before/after workflow, measures, reflection, and reusable template
notes: Report actual results honestly; do not invent impact metrics.
